Hard line breaks rendered with trailing spaces

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"newline_style\":\"Spaces\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>First<br>Second</p>", options)
```
